description: Claude Code via the registry ACP adapter (@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp). Subscription access stays in your Claude Code login; Garuda never reads it.
setup: 1. Install Node.js 22+ and Claude Code, then authenticate with your Claude Pro/Max login. 2. Run: npm install -g @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@0.85.0. 3. Verify: claude-agent-acp --version. Garuda never reads ~/.claude/.credentials.json or the macOS Keychain entry; Garuda does not pass ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to the adapter, so it uses your default Claude Code login.

login.instructions: Run `claude login` with your Claude Pro/Max account, then select this runtime.
